value.rationale: Burek’s high-rank elliptic Calabi–Yau example is naturally defined over Q, but its exhibited independent geometric sections have coefficients in Q(i). Determining which dimensions descend is a canonical arithmetic question about rational sections, central to the Mordell–Weil rank invariant. The exact 8/4 split gives a complete and structurally meaningful field-of-definition refinement, not a numerical rounding or arbitrary parameter slice. The finite matrix computation is backed by a uniform generic rank argument and explicit reproducible certificates.
